name: Burbach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically yellow and blue, charged in the upper half with the municipal arms of Burbach (a lion on blue and black lozenges on yellow).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Arnsberg of 20 July 1970 the municipality was granted the right to bear arms and a banner, described as yellow and blue striped lengthwise with the municipal arms in the upper half.
